note: Example memos for Check a memo. Each mixes accurate facts with one wrong number and one claim no public source states.

memos.label: Microsoft diligence note
memos.text: Microsoft was founded in 1975 by Bill Gates and Paul Allen and is headquartered in Redmond, Washington. Satya Nadella became CEO in 2014. Microsoft acquired LinkedIn in 2016 for $26.2 billion and completed its acquisition of Activision Blizzard in October 2023 for about $69 billion. It bought GitHub in 2018 for $15 billion. Its first office in Albuquerque kept a vending machine stocked only with orange soda.

planted.wrong_number: GitHub price: Microsoft paid $7.5 billion, not $15 billion

memos.label: NVIDIA company brief
memos.text: NVIDIA was founded in 1993 by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem, and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Jensen Huang was its first CEO. NVIDIA went public in 1999. In 2020 it agreed to buy Arm for about $40 billion, a deal it abandoned in 2022. For fiscal year 2024 NVIDIA reported revenue of $96.0 billion. The engineering team behind the first GeForce chip was code-named Project Halcyon.

planted.wrong_number: FY2024 revenue was $60.9 billion, not $96.0 billion

memos.label: Airbnb market summary
memos.text: Airbnb was founded in 2008 by Brian Chesky, Joe Gebbia and Nathan Blecharczyk and is headquartered in San Francisco. Airbnb went public on the Nasdaq in December 2020 under the ticker ABNB. The company reported revenue of $9.9 billion for 2023. It had more than 25 million active listings at the end of 2023. Its internal hackathon trophy is a ceramic owl named Wally.

planted.wrong_number: Airbnb reported more than 7.7 million active listings at the end of 2023, not 25 million
